payload.name: stage_decision

args.decision: Note to planning: re-sequence the October Tern T2 builds. Yunzhan force majeure (fire 18 September); Yunzhan says partial restart 6 to 8 weeks from its 22 September notice (latest 17 November); revised dates not yet given. Tern T2 October: up to 182 robots short (Tern T2 needs three affected parts: Motor BLDC HR-40110 short up to 364 EA, Motor DC gearmotor HR-40120 up to 182 EA, Brake electromagnetic HR-40130 up to 364 EA); November: up to 188 Tern T2 short. Stock on hand is not on file, so figures are up-to. Ask planning which Tern T2 October builds can move later without breaking a customer date, and move builds that do not use these parts earlier. No promises made, no dates invented.
args.reason: Re-sequencing is the only lever that does not wait on Yunzhan.

I've started drafting the note to planning on re-sequencing the October Tern T2 builds. It's still running, and nothing is staged yet. It will land on the case for your signature once it finishes.

The note will say:
- **Cause:** Yunzhan's fire stops the drive motors and brakes. Yunzhan says partial production restarts 6 to 8 weeks after its 22 September notice, and it hasn't given revised dates.
- **Tern T2 October:** up to 182 robots short. The parts behind that are:
  - Motor, BLDC (HR-40110), up to 364 EA short.
  - Motor, DC gearmotor (HR-40120), up to 182 EA short.
  - Brake, electromagnetic (HR-40130), up to 364 EA short.
- **Tern T2 November:** up to 188 robots short.
- **Ask:** which October Tern T2 builds can move later without breaking a customer date, and which builds that don't use these parts can move up.

Stock on hand isn't on file, so every figure is an upper bound.
